source_driven_timeline.subject: Chagall Vitebsk and the metaphor of suprematism as a sect; remember rhetorical character.
Impossible to settle enigma as rise/fall or beginning/end; object interrupts orientation.
1913 Victory Over the Sun and 1915 0,10; stage and solar eclipse, not simplistic allegory.
Tafuri, future and lost origins; window, mirror, cross and icon considered critically.
Public circulation of Black Square as group emblem, funeral symbol and small signature in late painting.
Late figurative work, absent faces, interpretation under Soviet rule unresolved.
Desert, infrastructure, parousia, arrival and perspective reversal following Pavel Florensky.
Black Square beyond normal and reversed perspectives, non-objectivity and a present active nothing.
Concluding unverified reference to unnamed Spanish painter, evening darkness and imagining dawn.

historic_context.item: Exhibition of Malevich at Fundacion Juan March Madrid in 1993, then Valencia at IVAM 21 July - 29 Aug 1993
El Lissitzky About Two Squares 1922 is actual suprematist historical milieu, not purely curatorial resemblance
Malevich Victory Over the Sun 1913 costume design from Commons; not original Black Square
Black Square reproduction used by site is identified by Commons as 1924 version

conceptual_links.reading: Artwork can prevent resolution into beginning/end or rise/fall, not merely symbolize mystery.
conceptual_links.candidate_practice: Draw a course interrupted by an opaque shape.

conceptual_links.reading: Black Square's circulation as monumental icon and late small signature changes its social function.
conceptual_links.candidate_practice: Apply one sign in very different scalar relations.

conceptual_links.reading: Reverse perspective and arrival of things into our field of vision, avoiding attribution of Florensky view to Malevich as simple theorem.
conceptual_links.candidate_practice: Interface reverses movement of viewer and image.

conceptual_links.reading: Last painting darkening as day ends, making perceived visibility an event with duration.
conceptual_links.candidate_practice: Observe image under changing ambient light; record observations.

conceptual_links.reading: Suprematism as community with emblems, rituals and conflicts, not identical with Goffman's framework
conceptual_links.candidate_practice: Compare symbol as emblem vs signer in group setting.
